title: Variable Time Delay
text: Delay input by variable amount of time, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial output} sets Initial output; {Select delay type} sets the type of delay Variable, {Maximum delay} sets the maximum value of time delay input, {Initial buffer size} sets the initial memory allocation, {Use fixed buffer size} uses fixed-size buffer, {Handle zero delay} sets the option to allow zero delay, {Direct feedthrough of input during linearization} sets the option to use zero delay during linearization and trimming, {Pade order (for linearization)} sets the order of Pade approximation, {Absolute tolerance} and {State Name (e.g., ’position’)} sets the unique name for each state. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: t 0
ports.summary: Time delay input scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: t i
ports.summary: Instantaneous time delay input scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Select delay type
params.values: Type of delay Variable time delay | Variable transport delay

params.values: Maximum value of time delay input 10 (default) | scalar | vector

params.values: Option to allow zero delay off (default) | on

params.values: Option to use zero delay during linearization and trimming operations off (default) | on

params.values: Absolute tolerance for computing block state auto (default) | positive, real, scalar or vector
